clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country and purchase of the orchard in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and letters to her sister, Walter's long hours away from home, Glen's fights at school, June's weeks in bed that first winter, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan after a quarrel, and rows between Walter and June over money for trees. By September 1953, June joined the church choir and her letters thinned out, marking where the family's most acute shifts settled.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drank heavily most nights, he and Glen blamed each other and clashed over the loan, Glen and Marian overfunctioned by taking over money and bank talks, Carl's asthma attacks worsened that winter, and Nora began wetting the bed in April. Ida's heart trouble was found in May and she stopped working. By October 1969, Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees, marking where the family settled.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's loss of his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen sat in the truck for hours most of that year with his functioning down, he and Marian fought loud at night over money, Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopped eating and lost weight, kept to her room away from her mother, and Walter started drinking again after six years. By June 1976, Nora was eating again and made the track team, marking where her shifts settled.

clusters.name: Wilma moved into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows while taking his mother's side, Owen had tantrums at preschool, Wilma took over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flared on both hands, and rows between Nora and Hollis became most nights. By June 1991, Wilma took a flat in town, and by August Nora's eczema cleared over the summer, marking where the family settled.
